audit.whatIsWrong: 2+ items was marked Sion in both layers while whys[6] on the same page tells you to close through objectives rather than 1v1 him.
audit.why: Subjugate takes a percentage of your health, armour and magic resist — the more you stack, the more it takes. A Sion who buys health all game is the worst possible late-game target for it, so the last row belongs to Trundle. The mirror audit already moved this row on the trundle side.
audit.corrected: Flipped 2+ items to Trundle as a matched full/content pair and dropped phases[6].rating from 6/10 to 3/10. Every other row already agreed with the packet chart and with the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike calls Subjugate 'a short cooldown' and describes it as stealing armour and MR only.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80 seconds — the longest cooldown in the lane and the entire reason a spent Subjugate is a two-minute window for you. It also steals health, not just resistances, and the amount stolen doubles over the following 4 seconds.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text and whys[6] with the real mechanic and the 120s rank-1 number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seven fields describe Chomp as dealing max-health damage. It does not.
audit.why: Riot's text for Chomp: damages, briefly slows, and saps some of the target's Attack Damage. The sap is attack damage, not health, and the kit carries no percentHealth flag on Q — the percentHealth flags on this champion sit on the passive and the ultimate, which is where the real max-health interaction lives. Telling a Sion that every bite scales with his health stack is the exact opposite of the truth and would push him off the build that wins the lane.
audit.corrected: Fixed in whys[0], wants.you[1], wants.foe[2] and early. Chomp also named with its 3.5s cooldown and auto-reset.
sources: mirrorFindings point 4 ('the sap corrected to attack damage')

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice never appears anywhere on the page, and neither does Frozen Domain's healing amplification.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain at 1000 range on a 21-second rank-1 cooldown, and Sion has no dash — it is the thing that turns a lost trade into a death. Frozen Domain increases his healing from all sources while he stands on it, which is why anti-heal timing and where you fight are the same decision.
audit.corrected: Both written into late, with the terrain-cuts-retreat instruction to hold Flash for the wall rather than the damage.

edits.after: Chomp is a 3.5-second auto-reset that saps your attack damage, and your shield is not up yet — charge in fog and do not auto-trade freely.

edits.before: His Q bite scales with your raw HP total late, so anti-heal (Thornmail) is mandatory to keep the drain manageable; close through objectives rather than raw 1v1 brawls.
edits.after: Subjugate takes a percent of your health, armour and MR and doubles it over 4 seconds — the bigger you build, the more it takes, so close through objectives, not 1v1 brawls.

edits.before: Trundle's Subjugate now steals a significant chunk of your armor and MR on a short cooldown — never commit to an all-in while it is available or you hand him the trade.
edits.after: Subjugate steals a percent of your health, armour and MR and doubles it over 4 seconds — 120 seconds at rank 1, so never all-in while it is up and always once it is spent.

edits.before: Trundle's Q bite scales with your raw HP total — the bigger you get, the more each hit hurts, so close the game through objectives rather than letting him drain-tank your entire stack.
edits.after: Subjugate takes a percent of your health, armour and MR and doubles it over 4 seconds — the more you stack, the more it takes, so close through objectives rather than trading stacks.

edits.after: Pop Soul Furnace before his bites — Chomp saps your attack damage, so shield first, then detonate back

edits.after: Fight inside Frozen Domain where his attack speed and all of his healing are increased, and drag the brawl past your shield

edits.before: At Level 1 Trundle has the cleaner opener — his Q bite deals max-HP damage on a short cooldown while your W-shield has not yet come online to absorb it. Stay at the tip of your Q range and charge in brush so he cannot see the wind-up; do not walk into his auto range to trade freely. At Level 2 your W-shield changes the math significantly: pop it right before his Q bite lands and the shield eats the max-HP chunk while your detonation ticks him back. Level 3 is your first real opportunity — get all three abilities and look for a charged Q knockup into immediate E armor-shred; if it lands he is at a heavy HP deficit before his Q bite can recover the difference.
edits.after: At Level 1 Trundle has the cleaner opener — Chomp is a 3.5-second auto-reset that saps your attack damage while your shield has not yet come online. Stay at the tip of your Q range and charge in brush so he cannot see the wind-up; do not walk into his auto range to trade freely. At Level 2 Soul Furnace changes the math: pop it right before the bite lands and the shield eats the chunk while your detonation ticks him back. Level 3 is your first real opportunity — with all three abilities up, look for a charged Q knockup into immediate E armour-shred; if it lands he is at a heavy deficit before King's Tribute heals it back off dying minions.

edits.before: Anti-heal is not optional — Thornmail or Bramble Vest strips the sustain out of both his Q bites and his Subjugate heal, which is what keeps you even rather than behind in prolonged fights. Your zombie passive (Glory in Death) is genuine threat insurance here: even if Trundle lands a Subjugate and turns a fight around, your reanimation forces him to keep fighting or disengage, and that psychological pressure is real. In side-lane splits his Q bite scales with your HP total, so do not let the game go to a 40-minute stalemate where each auto he lands hurts more — use your Unstoppable Onslaught transit speed to take towers and force objectives before his drain pattern outscales your bulk.
edits.after: Anti-heal is not optional — Bramble Vest early strips the sustain out of King's Tribute and out of Frozen Domain, which raises his healing from every source while he stands on it, and that zone is where he wants every fight to happen. Glory in Death is your insurance: even if he lands Subjugate and flips a fight, your reanimation forces him to keep committing. What actually kills you is Pillar of Ice — impassable terrain at 1000 range on a 21-second cooldown at rank 1, and you have no dash, so hold Flash for the wall and not for the damage. Use your R's transit speed to take towers and force objectives before Subjugate's percentage grows with every item you buy.

notes: The 'Chomp deals max-HP damage' error appears in eight places across this one matchup, including dontsFull[2].t ('Stack pure HP vs his bite') and report[0].t / tldr ('His bite shreds your HP'). I fixed the four content fields that are clean text; the full-layer ones — tldr, report[0].t, dontsFull[2].t, report[11].t — all sit in fields containing mojibake or are short enough to be skipped by the applier, so they still carry the false claim and need a separate pass. That wording looks templated, so it is worth grepping for 'bite' plus 'max-HP' across other owners facing Trundle. Left unverified, matching the mirror's decision: whether Pillar of Ice's terrain stops Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion's R carries a derived terrain flag but Riot's text describes colliding with an enemy, so I wrote the retreat-cutting consequence without claiming it stops your charge.
